comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from washers, versus loading a tensile-test dogbone into two spring-closed wedge grips.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual screen grasping and agitation versus holding spring jaws open, inserting thin tabs and jogging a crosshead into alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Mass recovery and workpiece retention versus both tabs seated, specimen straight at test length and grippers clear.
comparison.reason: The record tests precision specimen insertion and fixture alignment, not material screening.
